thesis: ASO is a genuine relative-strength leader: it sits above its SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200 with a +46% 63-day return while QQQ is in a risk-off drawdown. It is profitable, has low dilution risk, and trades at low absolute multiples (trailing P/E 11.66, forward 9.82). Short interest near 20% of float gives squeeze fuel if buyers keep pressing toward the 52-week high. The setup is weak, though. Reward/risk is only 1.2, the stock is extended and above the mean analyst target, growth is decelerating, the risk-off regime is a headwind for a consumer-cyclical retailer, and earnings add gap risk. This is a low-conviction long that only works on a pullback toward the entry zone low or a volume-confirmed breakout.
